title: Notifications
intro: Your approvals, unlocks, payments and withdrawals.
emptyBody: Approvals, unlocks and payments will be shown here.
emailFooter: You can also find this notification in your Umoja Jobs account.

offer_submitted.title: Offer sent for review
offer_submitted.body: Your offer “{offer}” has been received. The moderation team checks it before publication.

offer_approved.title: Offer approved
offer_approved.body: Your offer “{offer}” has been approved. It is published or will be on its start date.

offer_correction_requested.title: Correction requested
offer_correction_requested.body: Moderation asks for a correction to your offer “{offer}”: {reason}

offer_suspended.title: Offer suspended
offer_suspended.body: Your offer “{offer}” has been suspended by moderation: {reason}

offer_unlocked.title: Offer unlocked
offer_unlocked.body: You unlocked the offer “{offer}” for {credits} credits. Its application details remain available in your account.

commission_earned.title: New commission
commission_earned.body: Your offer “{offer}” was just unlocked: a commission of {amount} is pending.

commission_available.title: Commission available
commission_available.body: A commission of {amount} is now available for withdrawal.

credits_purchased.title: Top-up confirmed
credits_purchased.body: Your payment of {amount} is confirmed: {credits} credits have been added to your balance.

account_suspended.title: Account suspended
account_suspended.body: Your Umoja Jobs account has been suspended. For any question, contact our support.
